now.detail: The final rehearsal passed on all four quarters, including both rejection drills. Two earlier rehearsals stopped because too many real drafts were refused; the guards stayed, the drafting reminder was sharpened, and a ? may now touch a placeholder. Live runs one quarter at a time, each read by Sol. Word checks cannot judge support, so the panel still has to reject unsupported prose.
